description.zh: 六边形长期记忆插件 · v1.2.0 角色主线版：AI 语义判定 + 角色记忆隔离（每个角色只看到自己的记忆与全局记忆，互不串味），支持类型/重要性/敏感/空间/角色自动判定、冲突检测、艾宾浩斯复习、注入预算优化与液态玻璃管理面板。零外部依赖，无需 API Key。
description.en: Hexagon long-term memory plugin v1.2.0 with character lanes: AI decides what is worth remembering, and each character only sees its own memories plus global ones. Auto type/importance/sensitive/space/character tagging, conflict detection, Ebbinghaus review, injection budget tuning and a liquid-glass panel. No external API key required.
